purpose: Decomposes Pendle Finance yield tokenization: PT implied fixed yield, YT leverage and break-even APY, PT+YT=1 invariant check, and time-to-maturity analytics. Covers Pendle/Ethena sUSDe presets. Determines whether YT is profitable at current underlying APY and by how much. Not financial advice.
